criteria_verification.criterion_text: Test tears down tutor and asserts the KV row is removed within 30s.
criteria_verification.evidence: After the resolver assertions, the test calls adapter.stop() and then opens a fresh observer connection to poll the agent-registry bucket. A while-loop with a 30.0s deadline calls observer_registry.get(manifest.agent_id) every 100ms and breaks when the result is None; if the deadline elapses with the row still present, pytest.fail() is invoked with a message naming the Decision 1 graceful-deregister contract. Final assertions confirm adapter.is_ready is False and adapter.active_tasks == 0.
